# Valence UI — Full API Reference & LLM Knowledge Specification

> Complete, exhaustive specification of the Valence UI library for AI agents, developers, and LLM code generators.

Version: 0.0.1+
Architecture: Angular 19+ (Standalone Components, Signals API, ControlValueAccessor)
Design System: SCSS Native Utilities & Tokens (Manrope Font, Dark/Light Themes)
Author: Altivex

---

## 1. Global Setup & Installation

### Dependency Installation
```bash
npm install valence-ui @angular/cdk
```

### Style Integration
In `src/styles.scss`:
```scss
@use 'valence-ui/styles/main.scss';
@use 'valence-ui/themes/light/theme-light.scss'; // or theme-dark.scss
```

---

## 2. CSS Utility System (Prefix: `val-`)

### 2.1 Flexbox Utilities
* `val-flex`: `display: flex !important;`
* `val-inline-flex`: `display: inline-flex !important;`
* `val-flex-row`: `flex-direction: row;`
* `val-flex-column`: `flex-direction: column;`
* `val-flex-row-reverse`: `flex-direction: row-reverse;`
* `val-flex-column-reverse`: `flex-direction: column-reverse;`
* `val-flex-wrap`: `flex-wrap: wrap;`
* `val-flex-nowrap`: `flex-wrap: nowrap;`
* `val-justify-content-start`: `justify-content: flex-start;`
* `val-justify-content-end`: `justify-content: flex-end;`
* `val-justify-content-center`: `justify-content: center;`
* `val-justify-content-between`: `justify-content: space-between;`
* `val-justify-content-around`: `justify-content: space-around;`
* `val-justify-content-evenly`: `justify-content: space-evenly;`
* `val-align-items-start`: `align-items: flex-start;`
* `val-align-items-end`: `align-items: flex-end;`
* `val-align-items-center`: `align-items: center;`
* `val-align-items-baseline`: `align-items: baseline;`
* `val-align-items-stretch`: `align-items: stretch;`
* `val-flex-fill`: `flex: 1 1 auto;`
* `val-flex-grow-1` / `val-flex-grow-0`: `flex-grow`
* `val-flex-shrink-1` / `val-flex-shrink-0`: `flex-shrink`
* Responsive variants: `val-flex-md-row`, `val-flex-lg-column`, `val-justify-content-md-between`, etc.

### 2.2 Grid Utilities (12 Columns)
* `val-grid`: Flex grid container with negative margins.
* `val-col-1` to `val-col-12`: Column width spans.
* Responsive breakpoints (`sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`):
  * `val-col-12 val-col-md-6 val-col-lg-4 val-col-xl-3`
* `val-col-fixed`: Fixed width column.

### 2.3 Spacing & Gutters
Scale: `0` (0), `1` (0.25rem), `2` (0.5rem), `3` (1rem), `4` (1.5rem), `5` (3rem), `auto` (auto)
* Margin: `val-m-0` to `val-m-5`, `val-mt-*`, `val-mb-*`, `val-ml-*`, `val-mr-*`, `val-mx-*`, `val-my-*`, `val-mx-auto`
* Padding: `val-p-0` to `val-p-5`, `val-pt-*`, `val-pb-*`, `val-pl-*`, `val-pr-*`, `val-px-*`, `val-py-*`
* Gap: `val-gap-1` to `val-gap-5`, `val-row-gap-*`, `val-column-gap-*`

### 2.4 Typography & Text
* Font Family: `Manrope` (Variable Font included)
* Text Color: `val-text-primary`, `val-text-secondary`, `val-text-muted`, `val-text-danger`, `val-text-success`, `val-text-warning`, `val-text-info`
* Font Size: `val-text-xs` (0.75rem), `val-text-sm` (0.875rem), `val-text-base` (1rem), `val-text-lg` (1.125rem), `val-text-xl` (1.25rem), `val-text-2xl` (1.5rem), `val-text-3xl` (1.875rem)
* Weight: `val-font-light`, `val-font-normal`, `val-font-medium`, `val-font-semibold`, `val-font-bold`
* Alignment: `val-text-left`, `val-text-center`, `val-text-right`, `val-text-justify`
* Transform: `val-uppercase`, `val-lowercase`, `val-capitalize`

### 2.5 Borders, Radii, Rings & Shadows
* Border: `val-border`, `val-border-top`, `val-border-bottom`, `val-border-none`
* Border Radius: `val-rounded-none`, `val-rounded-sm`, `val-rounded`, `val-rounded-md`, `val-rounded-lg`, `val-rounded-xl`, `val-rounded-full`
* Focus Rings: `val-ring`, `val-ring-primary`, `val-ring-offset`
* Box Shadows: `val-shadow-none`, `val-shadow-sm`, `val-shadow-md`, `val-shadow-lg`, `val-shadow-xl`

---

## 3. Core Component Catalog & API Signatures

### 3.1 Buttons & Actions
#### `ButtonComponent`
* Selector: `val-button`, `button[val-button]`
* Import: `import { ButtonComponent } from 'valence-ui';`
* Inputs:
  * `label`: string
  * `icon`: ValIconName (icon identifier)
  * `iconPos`: 'left' | 'right' (default 'left')
  * `variant`: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'success' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'contrast' | 'outline-primary' | 'ghost-primary' | etc.
  * `size`: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default 'sm')
  * `boxShadow`: 'none' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  * `disabled`: boolean (default false)
  * `badge`: string | number
  * `badgeSeverity`: ValenceSeverity | ValenceColor
  * `badgeOverlay`: boolean (default true)
  * `type`: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'
* Outputs:
  * `onClick`: MouseEvent

#### `SpeedDialComponent`
* Selector: `val-speed-dial`
* Floating action speed-dial menu with expandable item buttons.

---

### 3.2 Containers & Layout
#### `CardComponent`
* Selector: `val-card`
* Directives: `ValCardHeaderDirective` (`[valCardHeader]`), `ValCardBodyDirective` (`[valCardBody]`), `ValCardFooterDirective` (`[valCardFooter]`), `ValCardBackDirective` (`[valCardBack]`)
* Inputs:
  * `bordered`: boolean (default true)
  * `hoverable`: boolean (default false)
  * `liftOnHover`: boolean (default false)
  * `boxShadow`: 'none' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' (default 'sm')
  * `flipped`: model<boolean> (supports 3D flip card toggle)

#### `PanelComponent` & `FieldsetComponent`
* Selectors: `val-panel`, `val-fieldset`
* Collapsible container panels with custom headers and toggle animations.

#### `ToolbarComponent`
* Selector: `val-toolbar`
* Standard application toolbars with `start`, `center`, and `end` content projection slots.

#### `DividerComponent`
* Selector: `val-divider`
* Layout separator supporting horizontal or vertical layout with optional text badges.

#### `SplitterComponent`
* Selector: `val-splitter`
* Resizable split view panes with drag handles.

---

### 3.3 Form Controls & Inputs (CVA Supported)

#### `FormFieldComponent`
* Selector: `val-form-field`
* Wrapper providing label, required asterisk, hint text, character count, and error validation messages.
* Inputs: `label` (string), `hint` (string), `required` (boolean), `error` (string).

#### `InputComponent` (`val-input`)
* Clean modern text input with prefix/suffix icons, clear button, and states.

#### `PasswordComponent` (`val-password`)
* Secure password field with reveal toggle and optional strength meter.

#### `DatePickerComponent` (`val-date-picker`) & `DateInputComponent`
* Calendar date selection with range, min/max date, and popup overlay.

#### `DropdownComponent` (`val-dropdown`)
* Single-select dropdown with search filter and custom item templates.

#### `MultiSelectComponent` (`val-multi-select`)
* Multi-select with chip display, select all, and virtual scrolling.

#### `CheckboxComponent` & `InputSwitchComponent`
* Native boolean toggles with animated states.

#### `OtpComponent` (`val-otp`)
* One-Time Password input supporting auto-focus tab advancement.

#### `SliderComponent` & `KnobComponent`
* Range inputs for continuous or stepped numeric values.

#### `ChipsComponent` (`val-chips`)
* Multi-tag text input with keyboard enter/backspace creation.

#### `ColorPickerComponent` (`val-color-picker`)
* Color selector with saturation/brightness area, hue bar, hex field and optional `presets`. Value is a `'#rrggbb'` string (or `null`). Popup by default; `[inline]="true"` keeps the panel visible.

#### `RatingComponent` (`val-rating`)
* Interactive star rating control.

#### `FileUploadComponent` (`val-file-upload`)
* Drag & drop file uploader with progress and previews.

---

### 3.4 Navigation Components

#### `TabsComponent` & `TabComponent`
* Selectors: `val-tabs`, `val-tab`
* Tab navigation with animated active pill and header icons.

#### `StepperComponent` & `StepComponent`
* Selectors: `val-stepper`, `val-step`
* Linear or non-linear multi-step wizards with transition animations.

#### `BreadcrumbComponent` (`val-breadcrumb`)
* Hierarchical route trail navigation.

#### `SidebarComponent` (`val-sidebar`)
* Off-canvas drawer sliding from `left`, `right`, `top`, or `bottom`.

#### `MenubarComponent`, `MegaMenuComponent`, `PanelMenuComponent`
* Multi-tier desktop and responsive dropdown application menus.

---

### 3.5 Data & Tables

#### `TableComponent` (`val-table`)
* Rich data table supporting sorting, filtering, row selection, zebra striping, and empty templates.

#### `PaginatorComponent` (`val-paginator`)
* Page navigation with rows-per-page selector, total records display, and first/prev/next/last jumps.

#### `TreeComponent` & `TreeTableComponent`
* Hierarchical tree structures and expandable table rows.

#### `TimelineComponent` (`val-timeline`)
* Chronological event timeline with custom markers and contents.

---

### 3.6 Overlays & Feedback Services

#### `ToastComponent` & `ToastService`
* Injectable service:
```typescript
import { ToastService } from 'valence-ui';

export class MyComp {
  private toast = inject(ToastService);
  
  show() {
    this.toast.add({
      severity: 'success', // 'success' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error'
      summary: 'Guardado',
      detail: 'Los datos fueron actualizados.',
      life: 3000
    });
  }
}
```

#### `DialogComponent` (`val-dialog`)
* Modal dialog overlay with backdrop blur, custom header/footer, and maximize/close controls.

#### `DynamicDialogService`
* Programmatically open components inside dialog windows without template declaration.

#### `ConfirmDialogComponent` & `ConfirmService`
* Confirm popups and modal verification workflows (`confirmService.confirm({ ... })`).

#### `TooltipDirective` (`[valTooltip]`)
* Floating tooltips with customizable position (`top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`).

#### `BlockUIComponent` (`val-block-ui`)
* Mask overlay to disable interactions during pending asynchronous operations.

---

### 3.7 Visual Indicators & Media

#### `AlertComponent` (`val-alert`)
* In-page notification banner with severity colors and dismiss button.

#### `BadgeComponent` (`val-badge`) & `TagComponent` (`val-tag`)
* Status pills, numerical counters, and label chips.

#### `SkeletonComponent` (`val-skeleton`)
* Loading state placeholders (circle, rectangle, card skeletons).

#### `ProgressBarComponent` & `ProgressSpinnerComponent`
* Determinate and indeterminate loading indicators.

#### `GalleriaComponent` & `CarouselComponent`
* Responsive image gallery viewers and rotating carousels with autoplay.

---

## 4. LLM Coding Conventions for Valence UI

1. **Always export and import standalone components:**
   ```typescript
   import { Component } from '@angular/core';
   import { ButtonComponent, CardComponent, InputComponent } from 'valence-ui';

   @Component({
     selector: 'app-example',
     standalone: true,
     imports: [ButtonComponent, CardComponent, InputComponent],
     template: `...`
   })
   export class ExampleComponent {}
   ```
2. **Prefer Valence UI utility classes over custom CSS:**
   * Use `class="val-flex val-items-center val-justify-between val-p-4"` instead of declaring `.header { display: flex; ... }`.
3. **Reactive Forms integration:**
   * Connect `[formControl]` or `formControlName` directly to `val-input`, `val-dropdown`, `val-checkbox`, etc., as they all implement `ControlValueAccessor`.
